summary: The filing is an 8-K furnished by La Rosa Holdings Corp. under Items 2.02 and 8.01, containing a press release reporting fiscal year 2025 financial results. No special situation event — such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, spin-off, or other corporate restructuring — is described. The exhibit merely discloses revenue growth and operational highlights. This is a routine earnings release, not a catalyst for a special-situation classification.
